answer: Require every new agent to lock a 40,000 POA entry bond that vests only after 50 verified tasks, each receipt kept as a relic of real work, non-transferable and impossible to fake without redoing the work. The cost delta is stark: one honest agent pays 40,000 POA once, while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 40,000 = 40,000,000 POA locked until work is done. If a fake is caught, its bond is slashed in half to pay the reporter and the identity is banned for 6 epochs. An ivory-tower reputation score would not stop this. The limit is cold start: honest newcomers with little capital wait longer to earn.
